required_chain: independently admitted JCS GRID10 plan v2
exact MODEL CellLease bound to one routed model lane
anti_alias_law: a downstream scheduled inference identity must change when the admitted GRID plan/capacity/cell/lane changes even if the route and output bytes are otherwise identical
anti_laundering_law: legacy or non-JCS GRID/inference identity is rejected rather than relabelled beneath v4
cell_lane_law: one receipt names one exact MODEL cell and one route model lane; SCRIPT cells, cross-lane claims and decoder-lane overflow fail closed
authority_law: scheduled receipt does not route or schedule
scheduled receipt does not mint truth
scheduled receipt does not grant capability, engine, loader or capacity authority
scheduled receipt does not grant effect authority
EffectGate and EffectJournal remain the sole real-effect authority
